_note: Fixed gold-case set for probing the stat-updates prompt's RELEVANCE (does it move the right stat, right direction, and leave irrelevant stats alone). Six self-descriptive stats spanning distinct axes; each case has an obvious correct answer. `expect` = stats that MUST change (with direction), `allow` = defensible secondaries that don't count as spurious, everything else is a trap. Run via harness/stat-relevance-probe.mjs.
world: A cold marsh country of river crossings and eel-fishing hamlets. You play Wren, a traveling mapmaker surveying the waterways on foot, carrying your instruments and a thin purse.

stats.name: Vigor
stats.description: Physical stamina and energy - spent by hard exertion, restored by rest and food.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Bodily condition - lowered by wounds and sickness, restored by healing and care.

stats.name: Resolve
stats.description: Willpower and morale - worn down by fear, loss, and despair, lifted by triumph and reassurance.

stats.name: Warmth
stats.description: How warm the body is - sapped by cold and wet, restored by fire, shelter, and dry clothes.

stats.name: Coin
stats.description: Money on hand - spent on goods and passage, gained by pay or found coin.

stats.name: Standing
stats.description: Reputation among the local folk - raised by kindness and competence shown them, lowered by offense or failure.

cases.name: exertion
cases.narration: You haul yourself hand over hand up the steep, root-tangled path, your pack dragging at your shoulders. By the top your arms are shaking and your breath saws in your chest - but you are up, and unhurt.

cases.name: injury
cases.narration: A fishhook snags deep into your palm as you haul the net, tearing a ragged gash. You work it free and bind the wound with a strip of cloth, but it throbs with every heartbeat and blood wells through the wrapping.

cases.name: spend-coin
cases.narration: You count six coppers into the ferryman's waiting palm. He grunts, pockets them without a word, and jerks his chin toward the waiting raft. The crossing is yours.

cases.name: cold-wet
cases.narration: You wade the shallows waist-deep, and the wind off the open marsh knifes straight through your soaked clothes. Your teeth clatter, and by the far bank you can no longer feel your fingers.

cases.name: social-win
cases.narration: You mend the old net-mender's torn seines without being asked, your fingers quick at the knots. Word travels the landing before you have finished; by dusk two more villagers greet you by name, and the eel-smoker sets aside her choicest fillet for you.

cases.name: null-idle
cases.narration: You stand at the rail and watch the mist coil slowly over the black water, your mind on the long road behind you. Nothing stirs but the sluggish current and a heron stepping through the reeds.

cases.name: morale-loss
cases.narration: The map you spent three weeks inking slips from the tube when the ferry lurches - the current takes it, unspooling the vellum into the dark before you can lunge for it. Three weeks of work, gone. You stare at the empty tube in your hands.

cases.name: rest-warm-food
cases.narration: You duck into the tavern's back room, peel off your soaked coat, and sink onto the bench by the roaring hearth. Heat seeps back into your bones, and a serving girl presses a bowl of hot eel stew into your hands. Slowly the shaking stops and strength trickles back.
